tools.name: schengen_check_days
tools.description: Calculate used and remaining Schengen short-stay days under the rolling 90/180-day rule from trips explicitly provided in this request. Trip dates are processed in memory and not stored. For planning only, not legal advice.

tools.name: schengen_earliest_reentry
tools.description: Find the earliest date a traveler can legally re-enter Schengen and the longest consecutive stay possible, from trips explicitly provided in this request. Trip dates are processed in memory and not stored. For planning only, not legal advice.

tools.name: etias_check
tools.description: Check the project’s current country classification: ETIAS-required, EU/EEA/Swiss free movement, or Schengen short-stay visa required. This country classification is informational and may change; verify current entry rules with official authorities.
